insurer: APA Life Assurance (formerly Apollo Life Assurance)
insurer_note: Rebrand from Apollo Life confirmed by a Capital FM article (capitalfm.africa/apollo-life-is-now-apa-life/, fetched; older piece). apalife.co.ke and apainsurance.org were blocked by the fetch allowlist, so the product list comes only from a third-party guide and contains names and one-line descriptions, no figures. APA Insurance (general) lists Upendo Life Plan (KES 200 monthly, KES 100,000 death benefit, per thekenyatimes.com) but that appears to be a general-insurer microproduct and is not included. HosiCare (hospital cash) skipped as medical. Apollo Balanced/Equity/Money Market funds are mentioned without details and skipped.
